scenes.say: Redux or something lighter? When is Redux actually worth using?

scenes.label: Structured
scenes.sub: Predictable state, devtools, but verbose setup
scenes.say: Redux gives you predictable state and powerful developer tools, but it can be verbose to set up.
Zustand and Context are easy to set up and great for small apps. Redux shines with advanced features for complex flows.

scenes.title: Zustand vs Redux
scenes.say: With Zustand, setup is often just one file. Redux usually means more files, middleware, and devtools integration.

scenes.question: Should you always use Redux?
scenes.right: No. Use Redux for complex, shared state—otherwise, lighter tools are better.
scenes.say: Should you always use Redux? No. Use Redux for complex, shared state. For simple needs, lighter tools are better.
